class.name: NNSTTickedNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for state tree nodes that are ticked by [NNSTRoot].
class.description: An active state can host roots under it. It starts them when it is entered, ticks them with the state's tick delta after its own [method on_tick] and any pending transition, and deactivates them when it is exited. A root counts as hosted when this state is its nearest host ancestor, so the enclosing [NNSTRoot]'s rate and process thread drive it and the root's own [code]process_thread[/code] is ignored. An [NNAgent]'s [member NNAgent.tick_rate] still throttles its thinking on the host's steps. A root nested inside another root's subtree is not hosted across that root; the nearest ancestor root owns its subtree. When a hosted root finishes, this state sends an event to its chart root with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event]: [member hosted_success_event] when it reported success and [member hosted_failure_event] when it reported failure. An empty event name sends nothing. [signal hosted_root_finished] also reports the same completion to any connection you make.

method.name: get_activation_generation
method.description: Returns a monotonically increasing token identifying the current (or most recent) activation of this state. It is incremented every time the state is entered, before any user callback runs. Queued automatic [constant NNSTRoot.STATE_ENTER] transitions carry this token so a request from an earlier activation can be discarded after a re-entry.

method.name: get_on_entered_condition
method.description: Returns the value used to determine if the state may be entered. Change by calling [method set_on_entered_condition]

method.name: get_root
method.description: Returns the [NNSTRoot] chart this node belongs to, resolved from its ancestors. A state that is removed from its chart while still active keeps reporting the chart it last belonged to, so [method on_exit_state] can still reach it. Returns [code]null[/code] when the node is not part of a state tree.

method.name: on_enter_condition
method.description: Do your logic here to decide when this node should be activated. Return [code]true[/code] or [code]false[/code] based on your logic. If this method isn't implemented in your node and no event is defined, this will return [code]true[/code]. This will execute before the corrosponding signal.

method.name: on_enter_state
method.description: Logic to initialize your state. This will execute before the corrosponding signal.

method.name: on_exit_state
method.description: Logic to clean up before exiting. This will execute before the corrosponding signal. A valid [method transition_to] call from this method replaces the transition that triggered the exit. Targets whose state or ancestors are still exiting are rejected to prevent activation of a lineage that the ongoing exit would undo.

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Logic to run when a state is ticked. This will execute before the corrosponding signal.

method.name: set_on_entered_condition
method.description: If no [method on_enter_condition] method exists, this value will be used to determine if the state may be entered.

method.name: transition_to
method.description: Transitions between states in the Stae Tree. Requires a [NodePath] (relative to the node calling this method) for the target state. During a transition, all active children of the *from* state will be exited and any children of the *to* state will be evaluated for entering. Returns [code]true[/code] if the transition was applied, or [code]false[/code] if it could not be (for example an invalid target, an inapplicable guard, or a branch that has not been entered yet). The transition runs synchronously, including the [method on_exit_state] and [method on_enter_state] callbacks of the states it leaves and enters. Events sent from those callbacks with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event] are queued on the [NNSTRoot] and only processed after this transition and every nested transition it caused have finished.

members.member: Defines how the child [NNConsiderations] nodes are aggregated into [member score]. The default is [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MULTIPLY].

The event this state sends to its chart root with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event] when a root hosted under it reports failure. An empty name sends nothing. The event is queued and handled by ordinary [NNSTTransition] nodes exactly like any other event, including transitions on this state or any of its ancestors. Every report sends an event, and a hosted behaviour tree that reached a terminal result starts a new run on the next host tick and reports again, so transition out of this state if it should only run once.

The event this state sends to its chart root with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event] when a root hosted under it reports success. An empty name sends nothing. The event is queued and handled by ordinary [NNSTTransition] nodes exactly like any other event, including transitions on this state or any of its ancestors. Every report sends an event, and a hosted behaviour tree that reached a terminal result starts a new run on the next host tick and reports again, so transition out of this state if it should only run once.

Marks this state as a final state of the chart. Entering it reports the chart as finished by emitting [signal NNSTRoot.finished] with [code]succeeded[/code] set to [code]true[/code]. This applies to every state type. A final state keeps ticking like any other state: it does not stop the chart or exit itself, so the chart keeps running until a host deactivates it or it is transitioned out.

A value (usually between 0 and 1) that affects the likelihood of this node being entered when the parent's [member NNSTBranchNodes.child_state_selection_rule] property is set to `UtilityScoring`. The highest scored child of the parent node will be selected. [b]Note:[/b] This value isn't set manually. It's calculated by adding [NNSTConsiderations] children that will be evaluated at time of scoring. Read-only runtime state that is never saved with the scene.

signal.name: event_received
signal.description: Emitted when this state receives an event sent with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event]. The event is delivered to the innermost active state first and bubbles up until a state consumes it, so a state only receives an event that reached it through its active child chain.

signal.name: hosted_root_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a root hosted under this state reports that a run finished. [param root] is the hosted root and [param succeeded] is its completion result. The same report also sends [member hosted_success_event] or [member hosted_failure_event] to the chart.

signal.name: state_check_enter_condition
signal.description: Emitted when the the [method on_enter_condition] check needs to be done. The signal must call the [method set_on_entered_condition] method with either [code]true[/code] or [code]false[/code] as the parameter to indicate if the state should be entered or not.

signal.name: state_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the state is entered. Add any state initialization to this signal handler.

signal.name: state_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the state is exited. Add any state deinitialization to this signal handler.

signal.name: state_ticked
signal.description: Emitted when the state is ticked. Add state update logic to this signal handler.

signal.name: transition_pending
signal.description: Emitted every tick while a delayed transition is pending for this state. [param initial_delay] is the delay that was requested and [param remaining_delay] is the time left, clamped at [code]0.0[/code] on the tick that takes the transition. Use [method NNSTTransition.take] with [code]immediately[/code] set to [code]false[/code], or give the transition a [member NNSTTransition.delay_in_seconds] value, to queue a transition.
